model: BREITLING Superocean Automatic 42 A17375211B1S1 (42 mm steel, black dial, black rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). FIRST BREITLING: structure of the Tudor Black Bay 54 rubber-strap build (smooth-bezel rotating dive bezel with insert, crown, rubber strap in side / centre / side sections) with its own measurements: ceramic insert inside a steel coin-edge ring, crown with guards (silhouette), block-lume minute hand, bar-lume hour hand, red-ringed lollipop seconds hand, textured-side rubber strap. Later Breitling variants (Superocean Heritage, Chronomat B01, Navitimer B01) copy this spec and change what differs.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 218 / bottoms y 734 px); the crown guards come from the silhouette; top and bottom slope toward the strap

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (bezel_in..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip measured as the thr-60 silhouette in rotated strips (so the 3D hands cover the photographed ones); the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon mirrored about the axis (hour: bar, minute: rectangular block, seconds: lollipop core). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crown with guards: the guards are part of the case silhouette (right edge x 758 px above and below the crown)

strap.note: strap.kind rubber: left / centre / right sections at the photo seams: centre_x_mm = [|y|, left x, right x] of the two vertical seams between the textured side sections and the smooth centre section (std-of-brightness scans every 10 px, 11.0548 px/mm about the pivot (512.0, 474.5)); the side sections start on the lug tops (top y 218, bottom y 734 px), the centre section runs from under the bezel; ends at the alpha silhouette (top y 104, bottom y 920). The strap flares toward the lugs and narrows toward the ends (silhouette).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
